name: ViewBookmarks
description: Mission-authored named map views. Admins declare bookmarks in Configure; users click one to fly there and optionally switch layers on.

descriptionFull.title: A list of named views (lon/lat/zoom, optional layer set) authored by mission admins in the Configure page. Clicking a bookmark moves the map and turns the bookmark's layers on.

bookmarks.name: Jezero Delta Front
bookmarks.description: Contact between the delta and crater floor

components.name: Bookmarks
components.description: The named views shown in the tool, in order. Each bookmark needs at least a name, longitude and latitude.

object.name: Name
object.description: Label shown in the bookmark list.

object.name: Group
object.description: Optional group heading. Bookmarks sharing a group are listed together when 'Group bookmarks' is on.

object.name: Icon
object.description: Optional Material Design Icon name (without the 'mdi-' prefix), e.g. 'map-marker' or 'crosshairs-gps'.

object.name: Description
object.description: Optional one-line note shown under the bookmark name when 'Show descriptions' is on.

object.name: Longitude
object.description: Center longitude of the view, in degrees.

object.name: Latitude
object.description: Center latitude of the view, in degrees.

object.name: Zoom
object.description: Zoom level for the view. Falls back to the 'Default zoom' below, then the map's current zoom.

object.name: Layers to turn on
object.description: Optional comma-separated layer names to switch on when the bookmark is used. Names must match the layer names in the Layers tab.

components.name: Default zoom
components.description: Zoom used for bookmarks that do not set their own zoom.

components.name: Show descriptions
components.description: Show each bookmark's description under its name.

components.name: Group bookmarks
components.description: Group the list under each bookmark's 'Group' heading. Ungrouped bookmarks are listed first.

components.name: Exclusive layers
components.description: When on, using a bookmark that declares layers turns every other toggleable layer off first, so only the bookmark's layers remain on.

author: MMGIS community
